ios.desc:
Why You'll Fall in Love with Vaux:

Intuitive Design: Forget about complicated user interfaces. Vaux is designed to make editing not just easy but enjoyable.
Tailored to Your Style: Choose between our sleek dark mode or classic light mode to match your aesthetic.
Feature-Rich Suite: From adding special effects to watermarks, Vaux provides a comprehensive range of editing capabilities.


Essential Features at a Glance:

Precision Cut & Trim: Edit your videos and audio files with pinpoint accuracy.
Music Infusion: Enliven your visuals by effortlessly adding music tracks.
Rewind & Relive: Experience your media files in reverse, for that extra creative touch.
Seamless Merge: Consolidate multiple video and audio files into one unified masterpiece.
Format Flexibility: Convert videos and audio to numerous formats including MP4, MKV, MPG, MOV, and many more.
Dynamic GIF Creation: Turn your videos into engaging GIFs.
Speed & Sound Control: Master the tempo and volume of your videos and audio files with ultimate precision.
Personalized Watermarking: Stamp your creative authority on your files with customizable watermarks.


Ideal For:
Capturing and sharing personal life stories and moments.
Crafting standout social media content for TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram.
Elevating corporate presentations and product showcases.
Realizing your vision in short films and documentaries.


Why Choose Vaux?

Effortless Usability: Perfectly suited for both novices and professionals.
Optimized Performance: Designed for efficiency with minimal CPU and memory footprint.
Stay Ahead: Regularly updated with fresh features and enhancements.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Vaux – The last video and audio editing app you'll ever need

quotes.text:
Hey HN,
I recently created Vaux:Video and audio editor to end the cycle of having to copy video and audio files to my computer for simple edits.

Unlike most video editing mobile apps out there that 'force' you to create a project before editing, Vaux loads up with an interface that let's you pick the action you want to perform, allows a few tweeks then exports the edited file. 
This is also aimed at the casual editor who just wants to perform a single editing task and move on.

The stack: I built Vaux using Flutter and FFMPEG library for the editing tasks.
Some of it's features include:
-Video FPS Modification
-Editing audio metadata
-Reversing video and audio
-Adding music
-Merging, trimming, cutting, muting
-Media Speed modification

I'm currently working on localization features to support multiple languages and would really appreciate your thoughts and feedback.

The app is available for both Android and iOS. Links below:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vaux.vaux_editor&pli=1

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vaux-video-and-audio-editor/id6475396889
